target: Paisaje de navegación de Las Tres Marcas en la Senda del Viento Bajo.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Tres bloques verticales naturales usados por viajeros como referencia de orientación durante la apertura progresiva de Korven hacia Edran.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: LOCATION / ENVIRONMENT / LANDSCAPE — NO CREATURE. Create a wide view of Las Tres Marcas. Three distinct upright natural rock blocks stand at different depths beside a hard travel route descending from fragmented Korven. Beyond them the terrain begins to open toward lower scrub and the distant Edran horizon. Their spacing and silhouette make them memorable as a navigation reference, but they are untouched geology, not monuments. Wind remains channeled near the rocks and weakens toward the open land. Cool-neutral daylight, gray stone, muted dry vegetation.
negative_constraints: No carved monoliths, statues, runes or standing-stone ritual site
No characters or creatures as focal subject
